newsitem.title: UK: Bandt to sell business to Wolseley unit.
newsitem.headline: Bandt to sell business to Wolseley unit.

text.p: Industrial products distributor Bandt Plc said on Friday it agreed to sell most of its Brown & Tawse Ltd business to a unit of Wolseley Plc for a total of 15.55 million stg.
Bandt said it would take an exceptional charge of 2.40 million stg for the year ending April 6 and a charge of 4.44 million stg related to goodwill previously written-off to reserves.
Brown & Tawse supplies tubes, valves and other pipeline products to the heating and ventilation markets.
Bandt said in a statement it would use the 15.05 million stg net from the disposal, of which 1.56 million stg will be deferred, to reduce its debt.
The company had gearing of 39 percent at Sept 30, compared with 44 percent a year earlier.
Bandt also reported first-half pretax profits of 1.44 million stg compared with 1.02 million in the year-ago period.
The company raised its interim dividend to 0.3p per share from nil a year earlier.
Bandt also said its commercial director, Robin Gisby, would be leaving the group on January 3.
